tools.name: search_cppreference
tools.description: Use when you need to find the official cppreference page for a C/C++ symbol, header, or language feature and don't know its URL. Returns up to 5 matching cppreference.com URLs; follow up with get_cppreference_page for the contents.

query.description: Concise C or C++ search query, such as a symbol, header, keyword, or concept (e.g. std::vector, constexpr, std::ranges::sort).

tools.name: get_cppreference_page
tools.description: Use when you have a cppreference.com URL and need the authoritative reference text for a symbol (semantics, overloads, since/deprecated/removed notes). Returns sanitized Markdown, paginated with a cursor for long pages.

url.description: HTTPS URL of a cppreference.com documentation page to retrieve.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call, or null/omitted for the first fragment.

tools.name: lookup_header
tools.description: Use when you need to know which ISO C/C++ header declares a symbol (e.g. 'where is std::span defined?'). Returns the header (<vector>, <algorithm>, <cstdio>, ...), first standard, category, and the C equivalent when one exists.

symbol.description: C or C++ symbol, type, function, class, or header name (e.g. 'std::vector', 'printf', 'std::views::filter', 'size_t', '<ranges>')

tools.name: check_cpp_standard
tools.description: Use when you must confirm whether a symbol/header exists in a target C/C++ standard (C++17, C++20, C++23, ...) or when it was introduced, deprecated, or removed. Returns the status and feature-test macro for that standard.

symbol.description: C or C++ symbol, type, function, class, or header name (e.g. 'std::span', 'std::auto_ptr', 'std::ranges::sort', 'std::print', '<format>')

standard.description: Target language standard to evaluate compatibility against (e.g. 'c++17', 'c++20', 'c++23', 'c11'). If omitted, returns general language availability.

tools.name: get_guideline
tools.description: Use when you need the official C++ Core Guidelines rule for an ID (F.16, R.1, C.21, I.11) or advice on an idiom (RAII, ownership, smart pointers, rule of five). Returns rule text, rationale, and enforcement.

query.description: Topic or search keyword (e.g. 'RAII', 'rule of five', 'ownership', 'smart pointers', 'pass by value', 'virtual destructor')

section.description: Filter by section name (e.g. 'Resource management', 'Functions', 'Classes and class hierarchies', 'Concurrency and parallelism')

include_content.description: Whether to include full markdown text and code examples in multi-match results (defaults to true for exact ruleId, false for broad query)

tools.name: get_cpp_modules_guide
tools.description: Use when writing or migrating to C++20/23/26 modules ('import std;', partitions, global module fragment, CMake 3.28+ setup, header migration). Returns architecture guides, rules, and code patterns by topic.

query.description: Search query across module rules and code patterns (e.g. 'ninja', 'private fragment', 'inline', 'macro', 'export import')

tools.name: check_module_toolchain
tools.description: Use when modules fail to build or navigate (module_not_found, 'import std' errors, incompatible BMI) or before choosing a toolchain for modules. Inspects clang++, g++, libc++ and clangd and reports which import std; setup is viable on this host.

tools.name: check_secure_coding
tools.description: Use when auditing C++ code for security, undefined behavior, or safety (e.g. before a commit or review), or to look up a SEI CERT C++ rule or CWE. Returns noncompliant examples and secure modern fixes.

rule_id.description: Specific SEI CERT rule ID (e.g. 'MEM50-CPP', 'OOP50-CPP', 'CON53-CPP', 'EXP54-CPP') or CWE ID (e.g. 'CWE-416', 'CWE-833')

category.description: SEI CERT category filter ('MEM' memory, 'CON' concurrency, 'EXP' expressions, 'OOP' object-oriented, 'ERR' exceptions, 'CTR' containers, 'STR' strings, 'INT' integers, 'FIO' input-output, 'DCL' declarations, 'MSC' miscellaneous)

query.description: Topic or vulnerability search keyword (e.g. 'use-after-free', 'deadlock', 'data race', 'slicing', 'virtual destructor', 'uninitialized')

code.description: C++ code snippet to inspect for common security and undefined behavior patterns (e.g. rand usage, exception-by-value, throw in destructor)

tools.name: get_cpp_tooling_guide
tools.description: Use when configuring or asking about C/C++ build and tooling (xmake with C++20 modules and official agent skills, .clang-format, .clang-tidy, LLVM/GCC sanitizers). Returns authoritative commands and production starter configs.

topic.description: Specific tooling topic or official xmake recipe (e.g. 'cxx-modules', 'cross-compilation', 'packages', 'cuda', 'unity', 'zigcc')

category.description: Category filter for official xmake recipes (e.g. 'basics', 'cli', 'languages', 'ops', 'packages', 'packaging', 'performance', 'project-config', 'scripting', 'testing', 'toolchains')

query.description: Search query across directives, CLI commands, configuration options, and xmake recipes (e.g. 'compile_commands', 'add_requires', 'modernize', 'IndentWidth', 'cuda')

generate_config.description: If true, outputs the raw, copy-pasteable production configuration file (e.g. xmake.lua, .clang-format, .clang-tidy)

tools.name: check_compiler_support
tools.description: Use when you need the minimum compiler versions (GCC, Clang, MSVC, Apple Clang) for a modern C++ feature, or to check whether a specific compiler version supports it (std::print, std::expected, import std, std::generator, coroutines, concepts, modules).

feature.description: C++ standard feature, library symbol, or keyword (e.g. 'std::print', 'expected', 'import std', 'generator', 'deducing this'). If omitted, returns an overview of features.

standard.description: Filter features by C++ standard version (e.g. 'C++20', 'C++23', 'C++26', 'C++17').

compiler.description: Specific compiler to check compatibility against.

version.description: User compiler version (e.g. '13.2', '16.0', 17) to evaluate compatibility against minimum requirements.

tools.name: demangle_symbol
tools.description: Use when a compiler or linker log contains mangled names (_ZN..., ?...) and you need readable signatures — or when you need to demangle a single symbol. Handles Itanium ABI (GCC/Clang) and MSVC.

symbol.description: Mangled symbol (e.g. '_ZNSt6vectorIiSaIiEE9push_backERKi', '_Z3addii', '?func@@YAHXZ') or an entire compiler/linker error trace containing mangled symbols.

strip_params.description: If true, strips function parameter types to return only the qualified name.

tools.name: search_code_symbols
tools.description: Use when you know a symbol's name but not where it is defined, or before calling analyze_code_symbol. Searches the indexed project workspace via clangd for classes, structs, functions, methods, and variables.

query.description: Symbol name or partial query to search for in workspace code (e.g. 'Calculator', 'Vec2', 'render').

workspaceDir.description: Project root directory containing xmake.lua, CMakeLists.txt, or compile_commands.json. Defaults to cwd.

files.description: Filter results to matching file names or relative paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching symbols to return (default: 25).

tools.name: analyze_code_symbol
tools.description: Use when you need deep semantics for one C++ symbol: definition, hover signature, docstrings, inheritance, incoming/outgoing call hierarchy, members, and usage examples. Runs a multi-dimensional clangd analysis.

symbol.description: Symbol name or qualified name to analyze (e.g. 'Calculator::add', 'Vec2', 'process').

workspaceDir.description: Project root directory containing xmake.lua, CMakeLists.txt, or compile_commands.json. Defaults to cwd.

file.description: Source file path hint for disambiguation.

maxExamples.description: Maximum number of usage references to extract (default: 5).

tools.name: get_project_details
tools.description: Use when you need to know how a workspace is built, why clangd tools fail, or which toolchain is available: returns the detected build system (xmake, CMake, compile_commands.json), indexed translation units, and clangd/xmake availability.

workspaceDir.description: Project root directory containing xmake.lua, CMakeLists.txt, or compile_commands.json. Defaults to cwd.

autoGenerate.description: Automatically generate compile_commands.json via xmake if missing (default: true).

tools.name: get_code_diagnostics
tools.description: Use when you need live compile errors and warnings for a file or in-memory snippet without running the build. Returns clangd diagnostics with line snippets and caret indicators; supports a severity filter.

file.description: Source or header file path to analyze (e.g. 'src/main.cpp'). If omitted, returns diagnostics across all tracked project files.

code.description: Optional in-memory source code to check without saving to disk. Requires 'file' to determine path and file type.

workspaceDir.description: Project root directory containing xmake.lua, CMakeLists.txt, or compile_commands.json. Defaults to cwd.

waitTimeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for clangd to parse and publish diagnostics (default: 3).

tools.name: rename_code_symbol
tools.description: Use when renaming a C++ symbol safely across the whole workspace. Performs AST-level rename of declarations, definitions and references via clangd without textual false positives; dry_run previews first.

symbol.description: Symbol name or qualified identifier to rename (e.g. 'Calculator::add', 'process_data').

new_name.description: New identifier name. Must be a valid C/C++ identifier.

workspaceDir.description: Project root directory containing xmake.lua, CMakeLists.txt, or compile_commands.json. Defaults to cwd.

file.description: Source file path hint for symbol location.

line.description: Line number hint (1-indexed) for symbol location.

dry_run.description: If true (default), returns preview diff of all affected files without modifying disk. If false, writes changes to disk.

tools.name: format_code
tools.description: Use when code must match the project's style (before a commit, after generation) or to format a snippet. Runs clang-format with .clang-format discovery, presets (LLVM, Google, Chromium, Mozilla, WebKit, Microsoft), line ranges, and atomic disk apply.

code.description: C/C++ code snippet to format in-memory. Ideal for formatting generated code before writing to disk.

file.description: Path to a C/C++ source or header file to format (.cpp, .hpp, .c, .h, .cxx, .ixx, .mpp).

workspace.description: Root workspace directory used to locate the project's .clang-format configuration file.

style.description: Coding style preset ('file' to use project .clang-format, 'LLVM', 'Google', 'Chromium', 'Mozilla', 'WebKit', 'Microsoft', or custom YAML string). Defaults to 'file'.

fallback_style.description: Fallback style if no .clang-format is found when style='file'. Defaults to 'LLVM'.

apply.description: If true and 'file' is provided, writes formatted changes directly to disk. Defaults to false (dry-run preview with unified diff).

start_line.description: Optional 1-indexed starting line number to format only a sub-region.

end_line.description: Optional 1-indexed ending line number to format only a sub-region.

tools.name: run_clang_tidy
tools.description: Use when modernizing or linting C/C++ code (e.g. std::cout -> std::print, NULL -> nullptr, raw new/delete) or gating CI on a check preset. Runs clang-tidy with presets (modernize, bugprone, performance, portability, cppcoreguidelines, cert, security, all) or a raw --checks expression; reports findings by default, apply=true writes fixes to disk.

files.description: Multiple files to analyze. Ignored when 'file' is set.

preset.description: Check group preset: 'modernize' (std::print/format, ranges, nullptr), 'bugprone', 'performance', 'portability', 'cppcoreguidelines', 'cert', 'security', or 'all'. Defaults to 'modernize'.

checks.description: Raw clang-tidy --checks expression; overrides 'preset' when set.

apply.description: If true, write clang-tidy fixes to disk (--fix --fix-errors). Defaults to false (report only, dry-run).

workspace.description: Root workspace directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

build_dir.description: Directory containing compile_commands.json. Auto-resolved when omitted.

extra_args.description: Extra raw arguments appended to every clang-tidy invocation.

tools.name: scaffold_project
tools.description: Use when starting a new C/C++ project and you want a best-practice skeleton. Scaffolds xmake/CMake with a chosen standard (C++11-26), test framework (Catch2/GTest/doctest), .clang-format, .clangd LSP config, and git.

project_name.description: Name of the project (alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens, and dots).

target_dir.description: Directory where the project should be created. Defaults to './<project_name>'.

build_system.description: Build system to use ('xmake' or 'cmake'). Defaults to 'xmake'.

project_type.description: Type of C++ project ('executable', 'library', 'header-only', 'cxx-modules', 'qt', 'cuda'). Defaults to 'executable'.

package_manager.description: Package manager ('xrepo', 'vcpkg', 'conan', 'none'). Defaults to 'xrepo' for xmake or 'none' for cmake.

init_clang_tools.description: Whether to generate .clang-format and .clangd LSP configurations. Defaults to true.

init_git.description: Whether to initialize a git repository in the target directory. Defaults to false.

dry_run.description: If true, returns file tree and previews without writing to disk. Defaults to false.

overwrite.description: If true, allows writing into an existing non-empty directory. Defaults to false.

tools.name: explain_compiler_error
tools.description: Use when a C/C++ build fails and you need the error decoded: massive template/SFINAE backtraces, unsatisfied C++20 concepts, undefined references, vtable issues, missing includes, or module resolution failures. Returns a plain-language diagnosis and fix.

error.description: Compiler error output or linker error trace (GCC, Clang, or MSVC error text).

compiler.description: Compiler flavor hint ('gcc', 'clang', 'msvc', or 'auto' to auto-detect). Defaults to 'auto'.

code_snippet.description: Optional source code context around the error location.

tools.name: generate_documentation
tools.description: Use when you need API documentation generated from C/C++ sources (Markdown, HTML, JSON, YAML) with Doxygen comments, types, and inheritance. Runs clang-doc non-destructively (manifest-tracked outputs).

workspace.description: Project workspace directory containing compile_commands.json, xmake.lua, or CMakeLists.txt (defaults to current directory).

files.description: Optional specific source or header files to document.

format.description: Documentation output format: 'md', 'html', 'json', or 'yaml'. Defaults to 'md'.

dry_run.description: Preview generation without writing files to disk.

tools.name: generate_compilation_database
tools.description: Use when clangd or clang tools report a missing compile_commands.json, when symbols don't resolve, or when setting up semantic intelligence for a project without a build system. Generates or resolves the database for CMake, xmake, Meson, Bear, or synthetic mode.

workspace.description: Project workspace directory containing build files or C/C++ source code (defaults to current directory).

build_system.description: Build system generator to use: 'auto', 'cmake', 'xmake', 'meson', 'bear', or 'synthetic' (default: 'auto').

build_dir.description: Directory for build artifacts and compile_commands.json (defaults to 'build').

std.description: C/C++ standard flag for synthetic generation (e.g. 'c++20', 'c++17').

include_dirs.description: Additional include directories for synthetic generation.

symlink_to_root.description: Link or copy the generated compile_commands.json to workspace root for automatic clangd discovery.

dry_run.description: Preview generation without writing files to disk.

tools.name: reorder_struct_fields
tools.description: Use when optimizing a struct/class memory layout or reordering members safely. Runs clang-reorder-fields and updates field declarations, constructor initializer lists, aggregate initializers, and C++20 designated initializers across the codebase.

record_name.description: Fully-qualified name of the struct or class to reorder (e.g. 'Foo' or '::bar::Foo').

fields_order.description: The desired order of field names (e.g. ['z', 'w', 'y', 'x']).

workspace.description: Workspace directory containing source files or compile_commands.json (defaults to current directory).

files.description: Optional specific source or header files to inspect and update.

apply.description: When true, writes rewritten changes to disk. When false (default), returns preview diff.

tools.name: trace_preprocessor
tools.description: Use when debugging macro expansion or conditional compilation. Traces pp-trace activity — #define/#undef, #include, #if/#ifdef/#elif branches, pragmas, module imports — as an aggregated summary, filtering system-header noise by default.

file.description: Path to the C/C++ source file to trace (absolute or relative to 'workspace').

workspace.description: Workspace directory used to resolve the file and locate compile_commands.json (defaults to current directory).

callbacks.description: Restrict tracing to specific pp-trace callbacks or globs (e.g. ['MacroDefined', 'MacroExpands']).

max_events.description: Maximum number of raw events retained when 'include_events' is true (default 500, max 10000).

include_events.description: When true, also return the raw callback events (capped by 'max_events').

user_files_only.description: Filter out events from system headers and virtual files, keeping only project code (default true).
